q: Which halogen has the highest boiling point (mass 254)?
Bromine has mass 160. State its state at 25 °C.
Liquid: it melts below 25 °C and boils at 59 °C.
Describe the relationship between mass and boiling point.
Explain the trend in terms of forces between molecules.
Larger molecules have more electrons and more contact, so stronger forces between molecules: more energy is needed to separate them.
